column1: # inn_rc_oct24 arms, read by submit_inn_rc_oct24.sbatch when the job STARTS (edit here, in place, before it starts).
# Columns (tab-separated, 4): index, arm, flags beyond common.args ('-' = none; later flags win), the arm's share of the
# card's memory (--cuda_memory_fraction; the qm9rc-only prior ran at 13.4 GB on a 16 GB card locally, the all-family
# prior is about six times its rows). All arms run at once on one A100 under MPS.
#   rcq        qm9rc only: the qm9full SMILES, one random conformer each (the control)
#   rcall      every family of installment 1: qm9rc + csdrc + zincrc + gdbrc + pubrc
#   rcall_big  as rcall, with the wider and deeper conditioner of inn_atoms_oct21's atoms_big
# Every arm is scored on the same held-out set (common.args: the qm9rc held-out molecules).
